name: Mirrorlane
description: Pro trading terminal with a dockable workspace, advanced orders, hotkeys, trader focused analytics and much more.
longDescription:
Mirrorlane is a pro trading terminal for Lighter. Trade every market on Lighter, 200+ perps and spot markets from Bitcoin to Nvidia, gold, FX and ETFs, around the clock.

It's for active traders who want a screen arranged their way, orders sent from the keyboard or the chart, and an exact read on what their trading earns after costs.

## What you get

- **A workspace you arrange.** Keep layouts in tabs, start from eight templates, dock any widget anywhere, link panes by colour so they follow one market, pop a widget out into its own window and share a layout by link. Six themes.
- **Orders for every size.** Market, limit, stop, TP / SL, Scale, TWAP, Advanced TWAP, Chase limit, Iceberg, and baskets on several markets at once.
- **Speed.** Set your own order hotkeys, trade with a click on the chart, drag limit and stop lines on the chart, size each trade from the loss you accept, and search or run commands from your keyboard.
- **Deep analytics.** See what every trade really made after fees and funding: results in R, risk at entry, winners against losers, how far each trade ran, what costs took and a year of daily PnL. It also shows which markets, sessions and habits make you money, and shows a pattern only when it holds up at 95% confidence.
- **Market tools.** A page for every market, up to four markets compared on one chart, every order at a price level in queue order, a heatmap, a watchlist, and alerts on price, funding and liquidation distance while the terminal is open.
- **Traders.** A leaderboard by PnL, ROI, volume or account value, trader profiles, and View as, which shows the trade screen as another trader sees it.
- **Sharing and exports.** PnL cards for a position, a closed trade or your whole portfolio, and exports of your trades or funding for any range.

Works on your phone, tablet and desktop.

## Why it's useful on Lighter

- **The same account.** Already on Lighter? Skip the deposit: connect your wallet, enable trading and your past trades load. Lighter's app shows the same balances, positions and orders, and Mirrorlane never holds your funds.
- **New to Lighter?** Deposit from any of 14 networks. A first trade usually takes a few minutes.
- **Low fees.** On a Plus account, perps cost 0.025% of each trade, maker or taker, which is $2.50 on $10,000, and spot costs 0.045%. No subscription. Premium has its own rates, listed in the docs. Mirrorlane trades on Plus or Premium, and the account type you pick applies in Lighter's app too.

Terminal: https://app.mirrorlane.io/trade

Docs: https://docs.mirrorlane.io
